# httphandler

```go
import "goliath/pkg/httphandler"
```

Package httphandler registers a small set of common HTTP endpoints on a standard library \*http.ServeMux. It has no third\-party dependencies.

It exposes three probes, each on its own path so orchestrators such as Kubernetes can target them independently:

- a health check \(GET /healthcheck\) that confirms the process is up,
- a liveness probe \(GET /livez\) that fails when the process is unrecoverable and should be restarted,
- a readiness probe \(GET /readyz\) that fails when the process is up but not yet able to serve traffic, so it is pulled from rotation.

Liveness and readiness run any checks registered for them and report ready only when every check passes. A failing probe returns 503 with a JSON body naming the failed checks; a passing probe returns 200.

### Usage

```
h := httphandler.New(
    httphandler.WithReadinessCheck("db", func(ctx context.Context) error {
        return db.PingContext(ctx)
    }),
)
mux := http.NewServeMux()
h.Register(mux)
http.ListenAndServe(":8080", mux)
```

Register may target any \*http.ServeMux, so these endpoints can share a mux with an application's own routes.

## Constants

<a name="DefaultHealthPath"></a>Default paths served by a Handler. Override them with WithHealthPath, WithReadinessPath, and WithLivenessPath.

```go
const (
    // DefaultHealthPath is the path served for the simple health check.
    DefaultHealthPath = "/healthcheck"
    // DefaultReadinessPath is the path served for the readiness probe.
    DefaultReadinessPath = "/readyz"
    // DefaultLivenessPath is the path served for the liveness probe.
    DefaultLivenessPath = "/livez"
)
```

<a name="Check"></a>
## type [Check](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/options.go#L8>)

Check reports whether a dependency is healthy. It returns nil when the dependency is ready and a non\-nil error describing the problem otherwise. The context carries the request deadline, so a Check should respect cancellation.

```go
type Check func(ctx context.Context) error
```

<a name="Handler"></a>
## type [Handler](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/httphandler.go#L68-L74>)

Handler serves the health, liveness, and readiness endpoints. Create one with New and wire it into a mux with Register.

```go
type Handler struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/httphandler.go#L79>)

```go
func New(opts ...Option) *Handler
```

New creates a Handler configured by the given options. With no options it serves the default paths, a liveness probe with no checks, and a readiness probe with no checks \(both of which then simply confirm the process is up\).

<a name="Handler.Register"></a>
### func \(\*Handler\) [Register](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/httphandler.go#L100>)

```go
func (h *Handler) Register(mux *http.ServeMux)
```

Register mounts the Handler's endpoints on mux. It registers the health, liveness, and readiness paths, each restricted to GET.

<a name="Option"></a>
## type [Option](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/options.go#L20>)

Option configures a Handler in New.

```go
type Option func(*options)
```

<a name="WithHealthPath"></a>
### func [WithHealthPath](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/options.go#L24>)

```go
func WithHealthPath(path string) Option
```

WithHealthPath overrides the path served for the simple health check. Empty values are ignored. The default is DefaultHealthPath.

<a name="WithLivenessCheck"></a>
### func [WithLivenessCheck](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/options.go#L71>)

```go
func WithLivenessCheck(name string, fn Check) Option
```

WithLivenessCheck registers a named check run by the liveness probe. The probe reports alive only when every registered check returns nil. With no checks the probe simply confirms the process is running. Registering the same name twice replaces the earlier check. A nil fn is ignored.

<a name="WithLivenessPath"></a>
### func [WithLivenessPath](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/options.go#L44>)

```go
func WithLivenessPath(path string) Option
```

WithLivenessPath overrides the path served for the liveness probe. Empty values are ignored. The default is DefaultLivenessPath.

<a name="WithReadinessCheck"></a>
### func [WithReadinessCheck](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/options.go#L55>)

```go
func WithReadinessCheck(name string, fn Check) Option
```

WithReadinessCheck registers a named check run by the readiness probe. The probe reports ready only when every registered check returns nil. Registering the same name twice replaces the earlier check. A nil fn is ignored.

<a name="WithReadinessPath"></a>
### func [WithReadinessPath](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/options.go#L34>)

```go
func WithReadinessPath(path string) Option
```

WithReadinessPath overrides the path served for the readiness probe. Empty values are ignored. The default is DefaultReadinessPath.

<a name="Status"></a>
## type [Status](<https://github.com/xwinata/goliath/blob/main/pkg/httphandler/httphandler.go#L50>)

Status is the string reported in a probe response body.

```go
type Status string
```

<a name="StatusOK"></a>

```go
const (
    // StatusOK is reported when a probe passes.
    StatusOK Status = "ok"
    // StatusUnavailable is reported when a probe fails.
    StatusUnavailable Status = "unavailable"
)
```
